content.value: Epic wish: a Barkpark Cloud operator console where we feel in total control and EVERYTHING WORKS. The bar is Sanity's manage console (manage.sanity.io) — not its skin, its completeness: every meter live, every toggle wired, no dead panels, no curl-only capabilities. Controlling WEBHOOKS from the GUI is the explicit top user priority. The per-instance USAGE METERING pipeline is the biggest net-new subsystem — meters must be truth. Non-negotiable: a panel ships only with its live backend wired and TESTED, or not at all. Source of truth: paper cloud-console-epic-wish. || [WAVE 3 — 2026-07-03] Waves C1-C7 SHIPPED (1002-1037). Goal kept OPEN as the living binding parent for wave-3 follow-ups: cloud-console-c10-members-usage, cloud-console-c11-live-meters, cloud-console-rollback-gui.
Ready for execution. 3 of 6 recorded acceptance criteria are marked met.

purpose.statement: Deliver one production operator console where every Cloud control works and reports truthful state.
purpose.why: The larger goal is Cloud production operator console — give operators complete, safe control over live infrastructure through one coherent GUI and CLI contract. The concrete problem was that critical controls were scattered across CLI commands, incomplete Studio panels, and manual operational knowledge. Building shared server primitives with matching GUI and CLI surfaces, then closing the goal from merged and live evidence was the correct intervention because one underlying contract prevents surface drift while dedicated interfaces support both people and automation. If omitted, routine operations remain risky, slow, and dependent on repository insiders.
